variants.title: Version 1 · C · complete bout medians
variants.description: Each complete detected bout’s median log vigor is repeated on its eligible samples, before the plotting crop. No 0.5 s binning.
variants.baseline: All eligible timepoints within [−15, 0) s, each carrying its complete bout’s median value.

variants.title: Version 1 · D · complete bout medians
variants.description: The same complete-bout medians and eligible sample intervals, with the median-preserving D denominator.
variants.baseline: All eligible timepoints within [−15, 0) s, each carrying its complete bout’s median value.

variants.title: Version 2 · C · direct 0.5 s means
variants.description: Each displayed cell averages direct eligible framewise natural-log vigor, without bout-median substitution. Its baseline reference is calculated from these same unscaled bin means.
variants.baseline: Finite unscaled 0.5 s baseline-bin means within [−15, 0) s; one vote per finite bin. The displayed baseline median is zero.

variants.title: Version 4 · direct 0.25 s means
variants.description: Each quarter-second cell averages direct eligible framewise natural-log vigor. Non-bout and invalid/ineligible samples remain NaN and are ignored. No minimum coverage threshold, no bout-median substitution, and no minimum-value replacement.
variants.baseline: Arithmetic mean of finite unscaled 0.25 s bin means in [−20, 0) s; one vote per finite bin, with all-NaN bins ignored. All 270 trial references are defined. Subtract this mean without scaling.
variants.formula: Δlog vigor = 0.25 s bin mean − mean(finite baseline-bin means in [−20, 0) s)

numeric_verification.baseline_zero: C/D sample baseline medians are zero; Version2 shares that reference but its displayed baseline-bin median need not be zero

complete_bout_reconstruction.status: corrected complete-bout review; supersedes crop-limited bout summaries and binned baselines
complete_bout_reconstruction.baseline: P10/P50/P90 from all eligible baseline timepoints carrying complete-bout median log values; same reference for every variant
complete_bout_reconstruction.bout_summary: median of every eligible log sample of each complete detected bout, beyond plotting crop
complete_bout_reconstruction.Version2: direct eligible framewise log means in 0.5 s cells; no bout-median substitution in displayed means
complete_bout_reconstruction.scaling: median-centred percentile C/D; conventional affine min-max rejected because it does not preserve baseline median zero

current_direct_bin_reference.status: Version2 baseline-bin population approved by user
current_direct_bin_reference.approval: Use baseline-bin means; guarantee displayed median zero (recommended)
current_direct_bin_reference.display: direct eligible framewise natural-log means in 0.5 s cells; no bout-median substitution
current_direct_bin_reference.baseline: finite unscaled baseline-bin means in [-15,0); one vote per finite bin; P10/P50/P90 NumPy linear
current_direct_bin_reference.sample_versions: unchanged complete-bout sample C/D; retain unbinned timepoint baseline

version4_bin_means.frame_value: direct eligible bout natural-log vigor; non-bout and invalid/ineligible frames remain NaN; no replacement/floor
version4_bin_means.bin_value: arithmetic mean of finite eligible natural-log vigor per 0.25 s bin; ignore NaNs; any one finite sample suffices
version4_bin_means.baseline: arithmetic mean of finite unscaled baseline-bin means in [-20,0); all-NaN bins ignored; one vote per finite bin
version4_bin_means.undefined_rule: whole trial undefined only if it has no finite baseline-bin means

current_example_trial_markers.status: provisional illustrative examples for a later panel E update
current_example_trial_markers.reason: match the legacy five phase positions, with at least 79/80 finite displayed bins and 29/30 finite baseline bins; not selected as maximal responders
